name: @finqbit/quantum-hub-brand-openedx
description: Quantum Hub's Paragon theme for the Open edX micro-frontends, derived from edly-io/brand-openedx (indigo-3.1.1).

scripts.build-tokens: npm run build-tokens:light && npm run build-tokens:dark
scripts.build: rm -rf dist paragon/build && mkdir dist && npm run compose-tokens && npm run build-tokens && npm run build-scss && node scripts/name-variants.mjs && npm run check-contrast
